finalText:
**A small Node JSON API, five files, no dependencies.**

```mermaid
graph LR
  server[server.js] --> auth[auth.js]
  server --> routes[routes.js]
  routes --> cache[cache.js]
  routes --> store[store.js]
  cache --> store
```

`server.js` takes the request, checks the token, and passes it on. `auth.js` signs and checks bearer tokens with a shared secret. `routes.js` maps method plus path to three handlers. Reads go through `cache.js`, a 256-entry recent-use cache. `store.js` keeps everything in memory, and records expire after 15 minutes.

One thing to watch: `routes.js` says writes clear the cached keys, but `putOrder` never does. So `GET /orders` can keep serving the old list after a new order.
